cards.ex: We should probably hit the road before traffic gets too bad.
cards.exUz: Trafik juda yomonlashishidan oldin yo'lga tushishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatga, uzoq yo'lga chiqishni boshlash.

cards.ex: I'm going to be late, I'm stuck in traffic downtown.
cards.exUz: Men kech qolaman, shahar markazida tirbandda qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobillar tirbandligi tufayli harakatlana olmaslik.

cards.ex: We had to take a detour because of road construction.
cards.exUz: Yo'l qurilishi tufayli aylanma yo'ldan yurishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy yo'ldan chetga chiqib, vaqtinchalik boshqa yo'ldan yurish.

cards.ex: I bought a round trip ticket to London.
cards.exUz: Men Londonga borib kelish bileti sotib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyga borib, keyin yana qaytib kelish.

cards.ex: I need to leave now if I want to catch the 8 o'clock train.
cards.exUz: Agar soat 8dagi poyezdga ulgurmoqchi bo'lsam, hozir ketishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Poyezd jo'nashidan oldin unga chiqishga vaqt topmoq.

cards.ex: I missed the bus and had to walk home.
cards.exUz: Men avtobusdan qoldim va uyga piyoda yurishga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Avtobus jo'nab ketganidan keyin bekatga yetib kelish.

cards.ex: It's easy to get around London using the Underground.
cards.exUz: Londonda metro orqali aylanib yurish oson.
cards.uzDef: Bir joydan ikkinchi joyga harakatlanish (shahar, hudud bo'ylab).

cards.ex: We wanted to find a restaurant off the beaten path.
cards.exUz: Biz sayyohlar kam boradigan restoranni topmoqchi edik.
cards.uzDef: Odatda sayyohlar bormaydigan, kam odam boradigan joy.

cards.ex: I've been on the move all day, attending meetings.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun davomida harakatda bo'ldim, yig'ilishlarda qatnashdim.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda bir joydan ikkinchi joyga ko'chib yurish.

cards.ex: We carpool to work to save money on gas.
cards.exUz: Biz benzindan tejash uchun ishga mashinada almashib boramiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta odamning bir mashinada birga borishi.

cards.ex: You need to slow down, you're driving too fast!
cards.exUz: Sekinlashishing kerak, juda tez haydading!
cards.uzDef: Tezlikni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: Speed up, we're going to be late!
cards.exUz: Tezlash, biz kech qolamiz!
cards.uzDef: Tezlikni oshirish.

cards.ex: I need to fill up the car with gas before we leave.
cards.exUz: Ketishimizdan oldin mashinaning bakini yoqilg'i bilan to'ldirishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositasining bakini yoqilg'i bilan to'ldirish.

cards.ex: I got a flat tire on the way to work this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab ishga ketayotganimda shinam teshildi.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobil shinasining havosi chiqib ketishi.

cards.ex: My mom is such a backseat driver; she always tells me how to drive.
cards.exUz: Oyim shunaqa orqa o'rindiq haydovchisi; u doim menga qanday haydashni aytadi.
cards.uzDef: Haydovchiga doim maslahat beradigan yo'lovchi.

cards.ex: The new train provides a smooth ride, even at high speeds.
cards.exUz: Yangi poyezd yuqori tezlikda ham ravon yo'lni ta'minlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qulay, tebranishsiz harakatlanish.

cards.ex: I always try to travel light when I go on vacation.
cards.exUz: Ta'tilga chiqqanimda doim yengil sayohat qilishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zingiz bilan kam narsa olib yurish.

cards.ex: We set off early in the morning to avoid the traffic.
cards.exUz: Trafikdan qochish uchun erta tongda yo'lga chiqdik.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatni yoki safarni boshlash.

cards.ex: This is going to be a long haul, so get comfortable.
cards.exUz: Bu uzoq masofa bo'ladi, shuning uchun qulay o'rnashing.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq masofaga sayohat yoki qiyin ish.

cards.ex: We need to plan a route before we start driving.
cards.exUz: Haydashni boshlashimizdan oldin yo'nalishni rejalashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat uchun eng yaxshi yo'lni aniqlash.

cards.ex: The project is on track and should be finished by next month.
cards.exUz: Loyiha reja bo'yicha ketmoqda va kelasi oyda tugashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilganidek davom etish.

cards.ex: I need you to back up the car so I can get out.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, mashinani orqaga haydang, shunda men chiqib keta olaman.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositasini orqaga haydash.

cards.ex: I have a connecting flight in Chicago, so I hope my first flight isn't delayed.
cards.exUz: Mening Chikagoda bog'lovchi reysim bor, shuning uchun birinchi reysim kechikmasligiga umid qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi reysdan keyin boshqa reysga o'tish.

cards.ex: Can you give me a lift to the station?
cards.exUz: Menga vokzalga bepul olib o'tishingiz mumkinmi?
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir mashinasida bepul borish.

cards.ex: I bought a one-way trip ticket because I don't know when I'll come back.
cards.exUz: Men bir tomonlama sayohat biletini sotib oldim, chunki qachon qaytishimni bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyga borib, qaytib kelmaslik.

cards.ex: Jump in, I'll give you a ride home.
cards.exUz: Sakrab o'tiring, men sizni uyga olib boraman.
cards.uzDef: Mashina yoki boshqa transport vositasiga tezda o'tirish.

cards.ex: Step on it! We're late!
cards.exUz: Gazni bosing! Biz kech qoldik!
cards.uzDef: Tezroq harakat qilish, tezlikni oshirish.

cards.ex: With the repairs complete, it's full speed ahead to reach the destination.
cards.exUz: Ta'mirlash ishlari tugallangandan so'ng, manzilga yetib borish uchun to'liq tezlikda oldinga.
cards.uzDef: To'liq tezlikda davom etish.

cards.ex: I'm at a crossroads in my career; I don't know what to do next.
cards.exUz: Men karyeramda chorrahada turibman; keyin nima qilishni bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish kerak bo'lgan muhim nuqtada.

cards.ex: We ran out of gas in the middle of nowhere.
cards.exUz: Biz hech qayerda benzinimiz tugab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobilda yoqilg'i qolmasligi.
